description: With dts.ack_wait_ms unset, dts.ack_wait runs for the derived value: the configured transmission length plus the longer LBT wait plus the longest contention wait.
note: As dts-arq/ack-wait-expiry-retransmit, except that dts.ack_wait_ms is not set. The standard gives no value for the wait (C-0911), so it is derived (C-1120) as the longest a peer with our settings takes to answer: the longer of csma.lbt_wait_dcd_ms 30000 and csma.lbt_wait_vdcd_ms 3000, the LBT wait it may use after hearing us (K-0067, K-0077), plus csma.num_cont_slots 16 times csma.cont_slot_width_ms 3000, the longest contention wait (K-0080), plus dts.max_transmission_ms 127500: 205500 ms. At 118350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with 205500; nothing is heard, and at 323850 FSN 0 is taken to have failed. LBT rule 3 (K-0071, K-0074): csma.lbt_wait 3000; at 326850 contention 45000 ms (third draw). At 371850 the same DATA-ONLY goes again, byte for byte, ending at 382200, when dts.ack_wait starts again with 205500. At 391000 RX LWE 1 acknowledges it: dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed (C-0679, C-1130) and dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): each 29-byte DATA-ONLY transmission leaves 21 bytes of its second block; no acknowledgement goes in it and its only addressee, 0.0.1.3, is recorded Ed4 (C-0050), so one PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes, EOT 10) follows the DATA-ONLY (C-0367, C-0887) and 10 bytes are zero filled.  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
